summary: Configured persistent, source-restricted SNMPv2c monitoring from node2 to node1. System identity, uptime, location, and contact are readable; writes are rejected. Both nodes retained CentOS Stream 10, kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64, and the unchanged asset register across sequential restarts.
actions_performed: Installed CentOS Stream 10 repository packages net-snmp 5.9.4 on node1 and net-snmp-utils 5.9.4 on node2.
Configured node1 with a system-branch-only read view, West Branch location, ops@branch.test contact, and node2-only network access.
Enabled persistent snmpd startup and a source-restricted firewalld rule for UDP/161.
Verified reads and explicit write rejection from node2.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: SNMPv2c access from node2 to node1 exposes system identity and uptime with the required location and contact
evidence.summary: Direct node2 queries returned sysDescr, sysObjectID, sysUpTime, sysContact=ops@branch.test, sysName=node1, and sysLocation=West Branch before and after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Community permits reads but rejects writes
evidence.summary: Reads succeeded, SNMP SET returned noAccess with exit code 2, and sysLocation remained West Branch.
snmpd is enabled and listening on UDP/161; firewalld permits UDP/161 only from node2, and both settings survived restart.
The register retained its SHA-256 da19717ac6440a3f765b43e60902dc7670b3d3ef133daa4a009a5f726fc6509a, size, ownership, permissions, and timestamp on both nodes.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel and use compatible software
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64; SNMP 5.9.4 packages came from the platform repositories.
Boot ID changed from 2c237d4f-82f7-45c7-a304-4536d3b717e8 to 476d24b5-4d99-42c2-88ba-21ebe3572e30; snmpd, firewall policy, asset data, and remote SNMP service recovered.
Boot ID changed from 4d842549-003e-4f78-bb26-12732f129e58 to 029b296a-d990-4463-b40b-6c14c3d26a9a; the SNMP client, asset data, remote reads, and write rejection recovered.
